visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a light blue iPhone showing an incoming call interface labeled '推銷' with no visible decline button. The scene is set on an office desk cluttered with a mechanical keyboard, small figurines, and a notepad. The lighting is bright and consistent across the workspace. (2) The camera pans to show a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue knitted cardigan, holding a large green and white plushie. She has a confused facial expression and looks directly at the phone screen held in front of her. (3) A screen recording interface takes over the frame, showing the iPhone lock screen and then navigating through the system settings. It enters 'Settings', then 'Accessibility', then 'Touch', highlighting specific toggles in the menu. (4) The woman returns to the frame in a medium shot, now smiling and holding the phone herself. She points her index finger up in a 'eureka' moment while leaning against her plush toy. (5) In the final segment, the woman is seen in a close-up, smiling broadly and looking at the camera with a playful expression. She holds the phone and the plushie close to her chest.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 推銷一直打電話來 很煩耶. [Logo]: @aottergirls. (2) [Subtitle]: 啊 沒有拒接鈕 我要怎麼拒接啊. (3) [Subtitle]: 按兩下電源鍵 就可以掛斷啦. (4) [Subtitle]: 欸 真的耶. (5) [Subtitle]: 喔~ 啊 可是 為什麼 有時候有拒接鈕 有時候沒有啊. (6) [Subtitle]: 那是因為 電話打來的時候 手機是鎖定狀態啦. (7) [Subtitle]: 這時候就只有 滑動來接聽. (8) [Subtitle]: 但你只要 按一下電源鍵 就能靜音. (9) [Subtitle]: 按兩下電源鍵 就能拒接了. (10) [Subtitle]: 那如果你怕 真的要接電話時 不小心按電源鍵掛斷. (11) [Subtitle]: 也可以到設定 輔助使用 觸控. (12) [Subtitle]: 把防止鎖定被用來 結束通話 這個功能打開就可以了喔. (13) [Subtitle]: 喔 但我才不要 開啟這個功能勒. (14) [Subtitle]: 啊 可是 剛剛那通電話 是我打給你的欸.
